title: Test: Edit Previous Requests
body:
Refs: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-copilot/issues/18304

- [x] anyOS @isidorn
- [x] anyOS @nguyenchristy
- [x] anyOS @pierceboggan 

Complexity: 4

Authors: @justschen


[Create Issue](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/new?template=blank&body=Testing+%23253081%0A%0A&assignees=justschen)

---

This iteration, we're experimenting with ways for users to edit previous requests that have been sent in chat. While editing, you can modify the request text content, attachments, model, and mode.

There are 3 main editing entry points. Finalized setting names to be determined! All versions support keyboard access (`enter`)
- Inline: Hover over the chat request bubble and click on the text to edit the request. 
- Hover: Hover over the chat request to show a toolbar. Clicking on the `edit` codicon will open the editing experience inline with the request.
- Input: Hover over the chat request to show a toolbar. Clicking on the `edit` codicon will open the editing experience in the original input box at the bottom of the chat panel.
- None: This is just the original behavior where an undo button is shown on hover. Clicking it will put the request text into the input box. 

## Test Steps
1. Make sure that `chat.editRequests` is enabled and set to `inline` (default). 
2. Try submitting new requests via edits, attaching context, closing out of the edits view, creating new chats, scrolling and tryping, or any other behaviour you think might be common!
3. Try a few scenarios like resizing, large requests, or scrolling the edit out of view. 
4. Via keyboard, try entering the edits flow by navigating to a request with `shift + tab` or with `cmd + up` and `up`. Press `enter` to begin editing. 
6. Repeat this for `input` and `hover. 
7. In all these scenarios, the toolbar should be accesible via `shift + tab`. You can completely undo a request by hitting the `undo` button in the toolbar, or by navigating to the request and hitting `cmd + backspace`

## Notes:
- This had some significant UI changes, so please let me know if anything breaks, and do your best to find any wonky edge cases or weird ui that you might experience
